request.summary: Build a fixed 480x270 pharmacy pickup queue for the fictional Greenline Pharmacy using an editable table datasource.
request.audience: Pharmacy customers scanning for their pickup ticket and counter from several metres away.
request.primaryGoal: Make the currently called ticket unmistakable while keeping the next few tickets readable and operational states accessible without relying on color.

assumptions: Datasource row order is the queue order because the requested table has no separate ordering field.
The first row in a called state is the active hero; completed rows are hidden and later called rows are not presented as waiting tickets.
When no ticket is currently called, the hero area asks customers to wait while the next-ticket list remains visible.
Unknown non-completed states remain visible with an explicit CHECK STATE label so unexpected edits do not silently remove a customer ticket.

surfaceStrategy.rationale: The request specifies one exact 480x270 pickup-counter canvas; the composition is optimized for that placement rather than generalized to unrelated ratios.

settings.purpose: Names the pharmacy in the compact header.
Explains that no pickup tickets are available.
Selects the coordinated Light, Dark, or Custom semantic palette.
Custom theme queue-order and waiting accent.
Custom theme hold and unknown-state accent.

dynamicText.fallback: Keep the Greenline cross mark and ellipsize only the end of the configured name.
dynamicText.rationale: The pharmacy identity is supporting wayfinding and must not displace the queue content.

dynamicText.fallback: Hide the optional note and next queue before fitting to 30px; at that floor preserve the readable ticket prefix and ellipsize the tail.
dynamicText.rationale: The active ticket is the board's primary message and must remain dominant and complete whenever physically possible.

dynamicText.fallback: Keep the counter direction cue and ellipsize the counter tail at the readable floor.
dynamicText.rationale: Customers must be able to pair the active ticket with its destination counter.

dynamicText.fallback: Remove the optional note when hero labels need the space, otherwise ellipsize its tail.
dynamicText.rationale: The note is useful context but is subordinate to ticket and counter readability.

dynamicText.fallback: Keep queue position and the start of the ticket visible while ellipsizing the tail.
dynamicText.rationale: Secondary tickets must stay on one scan line in the fixed compact list.

dynamicText.fallback: Ellipsize the counter tail before reducing the ticket label.
dynamicText.rationale: Counter context is useful for the next queue but remains secondary to ticket identity.

dynamicText.fallback: Limit the configured message to two complete centered lines.
dynamicText.rationale: The empty state should remain calm and readable without changing the board dimensions.

states.expectation: The coordinated dark palette preserves contrast and queue hierarchy.
Synthetic representative queue data appears before a datasource is selected.
A calm full-body empty state replaces the hero and next list.
A lone called ticket expands into the secondary region instead of leaving an empty list.
Long ticket, counter, pharmacy, and note text stays contained while the hero remains dominant.
Long upcoming ticket and counter labels ellipsize cleanly without disturbing row registration.
Only three upcoming tickets render and the remaining count is stated without growing the DOM.
An unrecognized state remains visible with an explicit question mark and CHECK STATE text cue.
Rows without ticket identity are ignored while valid rows remain stable.
Processed row-array output normalizes to the same queue model.
A live table edit replaces the active hero ticket without rebuilding the app.

behaviors.expectation: The first called row becomes the hero, completed rows are omitted, and waiting, hold, and unknown rows retain source order.
A datasource push updates the active ticket and counter in place.
An empty datasource still identifies the app and states why the surface is empty, in text legible at the declared viewing distance.

visualDirection.summary: A compact pharmacy reader board with clinical clarity, one deep-green announcement field, and a paper-light next queue.
signatureChoices: An oversized called ticket shares a single continuous surface with a tightly registered three-row queue.
A pharmacy cross, directional arrow, numbered queue positions, and written state labels make status understandable without color.
avoid: Generic dashboard cards, decorative medical imagery, and status meaning conveyed by colored dots alone.

visualReview.intent: The active ticket must read first from a distance, the counter second, and the upcoming queue third, with no wasted space on the tiny fixed canvas.
focus: Verify pathological ticket and counter labels do not force the hero below its readable minimum or clip text ink.
Verify empty, one-ticket, and many-waiting states use the whole 480x270 surface intentionally.
Verify waiting, hold, and unknown states remain distinguishable in grayscale through symbols and labels.
